preconditions.description: The length of the input string is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'MF' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of the characters 'M' and 'F'.

postconditions.description: The number of seconds needed is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if 'M' not in stdin or 'F' not in stdin else True
postconditions.description: If the line has only boys or only girls, the number of seconds needed is 0.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(sum(1 for i in range(len(stdin)) if stdin[i] == 'M' and 'F' in stdin[i+1:]) for _ in range(len(stdin))) if 'M' in stdin and 'F' in stdin else True
postconditions.description: The number of seconds needed is the maximum number of swaps required to move all girls in front of boys.
